# TerraFusion OS Infrastructure - AI Coding Agent Instructions

## Project Architecture Overview

TerraFusion OS uses a multi-workspace architecture with specialized team organization:
- `infrastructure/` - Infrastructure workspace (currently minimal - placeholder for future IaC)
- `backend/` - Server-side services with deployment scripts in `backend/scripts/`
- `frontend/` - UI applications requiring hosting infrastructure
- `config/` - Environment-specific configuration consumed by other workspaces
- `SDK/` - Integration layer requiring infrastructure resources
- `monitoring/` - Performance and quality tracking infrastructure
- `Core_Teams/`, `Platform_Teams/`, `Specialized_Teams/` - Team-specific workspaces

## Key Development Workflows

Deployment scripts are located in `backend/scripts/` (not in infrastructure workspace):
